title: CR-PAY-012 — Payments + AP/AR
preconds: Permissions (counted): WO: View, Customer: View; Vendor order and management: View, Invoicing V+E + See AP/AR. Auto-gate forced ON (not counted): See Fin. View Mode: Full unless noted. All other permissions OFF.
steps:
1. Create a custom role with the permissions listed in Preconditions; leave all others OFF.
  2. Assign the role to a test user and log in.
  3. Exercise each capability in Expected Result and confirm it succeeds (and that gated pricing is hidden where noted).
expected:
User CAN: Create invoices; process payments; deposits; send to terminal; AP/AR payment tabs (customer & vendor); aging; bulk payments from Unpaid Invoices tab

Risk / Rationale: Positive capability check — confirms this combination grants exactly the listed actions and nothing gated leaks.
Spec Ref: §1h+§5b
